newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 4.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:

* Malaysia's central bank, Bank Negara clarified new lending guidelines for property and share purchases to heads of local financial institutions. The chief executives of the commercial lenders said Bank Negara wanted banks exceeding the new lending limit to the property sector to submit their compliance plans by April 15. Banks and property stocks had been hit by new curbs imposed by Bank Negara last Friday in its 1996 annual report.
* In the U.S. the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost more ground, losing 39.66 points to 6,477.35.
* U.S. broking house Merrill Lynch said it had named Tenaga Nasioanal a global focus one stock. Merrill maintained Tenaga's rating of a near-term buy and long-term accumulate.
